record.label: Conditional-repair deployment card
record.summary: The 129-row target-free census validated the conditional-repair candidate in substance - every row finite and improving (minimum saving 206,167,895,046 FLOPs), maximum output delta 2.0483e-8 against a 1e-7 bar, every W total under 2^41 - but the frozen per-row floor of 2.6e11 failed on seven rows, so this spelling closed under its one-arm law. The independent v2 audit corrected the mechanism of record: savings equal exactly 22,907,543,894 FLOPs per certified skip with zero Cholesky fallbacks observed; low rows simply have more near-floor layers that never reach the gauge arm.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed measured under the frozen per-row gate; the corrected successor W2 re-gates the same hash-frozen target-free census with mechanism-correct conjuncts.
